body_markdown:
Hafnia recently hosted its second Pool Board Meeting of 2026 in Houston, USA. Over 20 Pool Partners from Europe, North and South America and Asia attended.


Houston has been a deliberate choice for hosting the Pools discussion – with US clean-product exports running at historically high levels, which has strengthened the US Gulf’s role as one of the world’s key swing suppliers.


The agenda covered how volatile geopolitics is shaping the tanker market. It included market research from Hafnia’s team and from guest speaker Dag Kilen, Head of Research at Fearnleys. Hafnia also presented its forecast, outlook and strategy, and set out the possible paths to market normalization (rapid, gradual or prolonged) and how the Pools are positioned for each.


The MR Pool continues to grow with an overall modern average age. Strong markets continue to provide optimal conditions for further fleet growth, with existing and new Partners adding 12 vessels since May 2026. Many of them being newbuilds with an average build year of 2020.


The October Pool Board Meeting concluded with Hafnia’s cocktail reception under The Houstonian’s iconic Live Oak Tree with Oil Majors, Charterers, Brokers, Pool Partners and Hafnia colleagues all in attendance.


We thank everyone who travelled to Houston and attended Hafnia’s Pool event – for their collaboration and participation.
